# Webbersaurus

> Web development and design company based in Branford, Connecticut, serving local businesses since 2007.

Webbersaurus is a web development company founded in 2007 by Chris Hauman. Based in Branford, CT, we specialize in designing user-friendly websites that help small and local businesses grow their online presence. We are proud members of the Shoreline Chamber of Commerce and have served over 150 clients with a perfect 5.0 Google rating across 28 reviews.

## Contact

- Phone: 203.530.7396
- Email: chris@webbersaur.us
- Location: Branford, CT
- Website: https://www.webbersaurus.com

## Services

### Web Development & Design
Custom website design and development for small businesses. Mobile-first responsive design, SEO-friendly architecture, and user-focused interfaces.

### SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Local SEO services including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and content strategy to improve search rankings for Connecticut businesses.

### Google Business Profile Management
Complete GBP setup and optimization including profile creation, photo management, review response strategy, post scheduling, and local search optimization.

### Change Portal
An AI-powered portal built into the client's own website that lets business owners submit changes by voice, text, or photo from any phone. Submissions are transcribed and drafted by AI, reviewed by Webbersaurus, and published to the live site in seconds. Unlimited changes are included in the monthly plan.

### Daily Specials
A managed system for restaurants to post daily and weekly specials to their own website in under a minute. Specials can be typed, dictated, or photographed from a phone, are formatted automatically to match the site, and expire on their own so nothing goes stale. Every special published is saved to a reusable list, so recurring dishes are ticked off rather than retyped. The same list can be exported as a printable PDF for table cards and emailed to a confirmed subscriber list. Live on Longley's, The Courtyard Restaurant, and Michael's Trattoria.

### Social Media Marketing
Social media management and content for local businesses, keeping profiles active and aligned with the rest of the client's online presence.

### Listing Pages for Realtors
Individual property listing pages built for real estate agents, designed to showcase a single property and be shared directly with buyers.

### Rate Your Experience (Online Review System)
A simple, powerful online review system that helps businesses turn customer feedback into growth and boost their online reputation.
